task.title: Tidy the phone board's remaining rough edges
task.description:
Left over from the reviews of PR #217 (2026-11-22). None blocks using the board on a phone.

- On a very slow connection one frame shows the wrong status button pressed before the remembered one. About 3.5 KB, mostly an HTML comment, sits between the status row and the script that picks the column; moving the comment above the row makes it much less likely.
- At 360x400 (keyboard up) with three notices showing, the status row sits under the notices until the page is scrolled about 90 px, and the third notice only peeks until the box is scrolled.
- The remembered column is kept per project key plus project name. Two projects with the same derived key and the default name share one when opened at the same address. Setup already mints a project ID; pass it to the page and key on that.
- A remembered status that is renamed falls back to the Up next column, because the page knows a status only by its token.
- The recorded desktop-layout comparison (TestBrowserDesktopLayoutMatchesTheRecording) runs only with WORKBOOK_TEST_DESKTOP_LAYOUT=1: it depends on the Chrome build, the machine's light or dark setting and its fonts. To run it in CI, pin the color scheme, treat flow-* and flex-* as equal, stop recording lengths that resolve from container units, and add a state with the three notices showing.
- When the board is briefly too busy to save, only the card says so; the detail form, a save refused after its form closed, and the comment thread still say the task changed elsewhere (from PR #216's review).
- Adding the board to a home screen was never tried on a real iPhone or Android phone.
